Welcome to **The Curious Notebook** — a space for simulations, notes, and small technical explorations.

I use this site to build intuition around ideas in robotics, machine learning, dynamics, and physical computation. 
Some pages are polished explainers. Others are working notes or toy models that help me understand an idea more clearly.
